svg.title: Where the bar's words sit on a wide window
svg.text: Where the bar's words sit on a wide window
A: words at the window's edges
B: words held to the page's columnNot picked
Drawn at 1920 wide, not 1280 (scaled to fit)
Going from My jobs to a job at this width, B's words move from 192 to 392; A's do not move.
A and B are the same bar at 768
A and B are the same bar at 375
Dashed lines mark the edges being compared. Figures are real px.
Scale: the 1280, 1920 and 768 frames at 0.5, the 375 frame at 0.75.
